definitions.explanation: A result in a competition where neither side wins.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The match ended in a draw.

examples.japanese: １⟦{対|たい}→対：noentry⟧１⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け⟦だった→だ：noentry⟧。

examples.english: We got one point from the draw.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦そうだ→そう：01167_sou⟧。
examples.english: Today's match looks like it will end in a draw.

examples.japanese: ３⟦{連|れん}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{勝|か}ちたがって→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Three draws in a row have continued, and the players are eager to win.

notes:
{引|ひ}き{分|わ}け describes a tie or draw in competitions where neither side wins.

FORMS:
⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull) + ⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧ (to divide) — both sides pull equally

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {引|ひ}き{分|わ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧: to end in a draw
- {引|ひ}き{分|わ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧: to force a draw
